title: Analysis of Islet Function by Insulin Enzyme-linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA)
author: IIDP-HIPP
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bz7bp9in
materials: Preparation of Samples, Standards, and internal Quality Controls
Preparation of enzyme conjugate and wash buffer solutions

Use Prism software to create graphs and to calculate stimulation index (SI) and area under curve (AUC) values. 4.5.1 Stimulation index (SI) is a ratio calculated as maximum response to a given stimulus relative to baseline. 4.5.2 Area under curve (AUC) is calculated by integrating islet secretory response to a given stimulus over time.

steps.title: Thaw and mix samples
steps.instruction: Thaw archived samples in room‑temperature water, then invert each capped tube ten times to mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Keep extracts on ice
steps.instruction: Retrieve the islet hormone extracts and keep them on ice until further use.

steps.title: Prepare calibrators, controls, and dilutions
steps.instruction: Set up all calibrators, antigen controls, and sample dilutions in 2 mL tubes as described.

substeps.instruction: Transfer all Calibrators and Antigen Controls from their original bottles into 2 mL tubes.

Prepare serial dilutions of the hormone extract (1:100, 1:1 000, 1:2 000, 1:5 000, 1:10 000) using Calibrator 0 media from the ELISA kit or Diabetes Sample Buffer; vortex each tube before making the next dilution.
Generate 1:3 dilutions of perifusion fractions #23, #24, #25, and #43 by adding 40 µL sample to 80 µL Calibrator 0 or Diabetes Sample Buffer in 2 mL tubes.

steps.title: Prepare assay reagents
steps.instruction: Make the enzyme conjugate and wash buffer solutions at 1× concentration.

substeps.instruction: Dilute Enzyme Conjugate 11× with Enzyme Conjugate Buffer to obtain a 1× solution; mix gently and prepare enough volume to add 100 µL per well.
Dilute Wash Buffer 21× with redistilled water to obtain a 1× solution; mix thoroughly and prepare enough volume to add 4.2 mL per well.

steps.title: Load plate with samples and standards
steps.instruction: Dispense samples, standards, and controls into the ELISA 96‑well plate and add enzyme conjugate.

substeps.instruction: Using an epMotion 5057 or hand‑pipetting, add 25 µL of each Calibrator, each Antigen Control (in duplicate), each sample, each extract dilution, and each perifusion‑fraction dilution to the appropriate wells.
Add 100 µL of the prepared Enzyme Conjugate 1× solution to every well.

steps.title: Incubate plate on shaker
steps.instruction: Place the plate on a microplate shaker set to 900 rpm (orbital) and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature (18‑25 °C).

steps.title: Wash plate
steps.instruction: Wash the plate six times with wash buffer and remove residual liquid.

substeps.instruction: Using the plate washer, dispense 700 µL of Wash Buffer 1× into each well and wash six times.
After the final wash, invert the plate and tap firmly against absorbent paper; do not include a soak step.

steps.title: Add substrate
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of TMB substrate to each well.

steps.title: Develop color
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate on the bench for 15 minutes at room temperature (18‑25 °C).

steps.title: Stop reaction
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of Stop Solution to each well and mix gently by tapping the plate for 5 seconds without dispersing the liquid.

steps.title: Read plate
steps.instruction: Within 30 minutes of adding stop solution, measure optical density at 450 nm with a microplate reader and calculate insulin concentrations.

steps.title: Validate assay performance
steps.instruction: Confirm that all standards are within ±15 % of expected values and have CV ≤ 20 %; ensure quality‑control samples fall within their known ranges; repeat the assay if any limits are exceeded.

steps.title: Calculate insulin content
steps.instruction: Average the insulin concentrations obtained from the four extract dilutions to obtain insulin content, expressed in ng/mL.

steps.title: Normalize insulin data
steps.instruction: Express secreted insulin per islet volume (IEQs) as ng/100 IEQs/min and express islet insulin content as % content/min.

steps.title: Document protocol deviations
steps.instruction: Record any deviations that occurred during the protocol that could affect final results and report them together with the assay analysis.
